browser.$tab_note: Every actor gets its OWN isolated tab tagged qa:<sessionKey>:<actor>. The engine never touches a tab it didn't create, so this run can share one Neko with other sessions safely — just give each run a distinct sessionKey (or set $QA_SESSION).
browser.$remote_note: For a REMOTE Neko, set mode to 'cdp' and cdpEndpoint to the remote host's exposed CDP, e.g. { "mode": "cdp", "cdpEndpoint": "${QA_NEKO_CDP}", "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer ${NEKO_TOKEN}" } }. Easiest remote path: SSH-tunnel the remote 9223 to localhost (ssh -N -L 9223:127.0.0.1:9223 user@remote) and keep this as http://127.0.0.1:9223.
